Looking at the site, I notice that `404.html` and `about.html` have copy/utility buttons (Copy URL, Copy UTC time) but lack the corresponding message span elements that `app.js` expects (`copy-url-msg`, `copy-current-time-msg`). This means button clicks produce no visible feedback on those pages. **Plan:** Add the missing message spans to both `404.html` and `about.html` for consistent UX. This is a small, coherent improvement across pages. **Files to rewrite:** `site/404.html`, `site/about.html`, `MEMORY.md` **Risk:** Low — purely additive HTML changes, no logic changes.```file:site/404.html 404 – Page Not Found · Momento Skip to main content
